description: This PHP source file contains JavaScript functions for client-side validation in import and form handling processes within the vtiger CRM application, as well as PHP functions to generate dynamic form elements and scripts.

methods.name: get_validate_import_fields_js
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for validating import fields on the client side based on required and all fields.

methods.name: get_validate_upload_js
methods.description: Creates JavaScript code for validating file upload form on the client side.

methods.name: getFieldSelect
methods.description: Builds an HTML select element for mapping source data fields to CRM fields during import.

methods.name: get_readonly_js
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript function to toggle readonly state of form input fields based on checkbox.
